note: Franklin County NE publishes no queryable zoning district service that I could find. Its planning page links an ArcGIS Experience whose Draft Documents page holds the Franklin County Draft Zoning Map and draft regulations only as Google Drive files. The county GIS portal (franklin.mipsgis.com) returned HTML only, with no ArcGIS REST services. The City of Franklin zoning ordinance is a PDF. The ArcGIS 'Zoning Map' items found belong to Franklin, Tennessee.
